local scn, done = ...
local function crate(pos)
  local e = ents.Create("prop_physics") e:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
  e:SetPos(pos) e:Spawn() e:Activate() return e
end
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local a = crate(Vector(700, -500, -123.6))   -- Ignite(360): the property's call, we watch 200 ticks
local b = crate(Vector(600, -500, -123.6))   -- Ignite(3): burns out
local c = crate(Vector(500, -500, -123.6))   -- Ignite(360) then Extinguish at t120
local dmg, sounds, samples, t = {}, {}, {}, 0
hook.Add("EntityTakeDamage", "parity_fire_dmg", function(ent, d)
  if ent == a or ent == b or ent == c then
    dmg[#dmg+1] = { t = t, ent = ent == a and "a" or ent == b and "b" or "c", amount = d:GetDamage(), type = d:GetDamageType(),
      inflictor = IsValid(d:GetInflictor()) and d:GetInflictor():GetClass() or "", attacker = IsValid(d:GetAttacker()) and d:GetAttacker():GetClass() or "" }
  end
end)
hook.Add("EntityEmitSound", "parity_fire_snd", function(d)
  sounds[#sounds+1] = { t = t, name = d.SoundName, orig = d.OriginalSoundName, vol = d.Volume, pitch = d.Pitch, level = d.SoundLevel, ent = IsValid(d.Entity) and d.Entity:GetClass() or "" }
end)
hook.Add("Think", "parity_fire", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == 10 then a:Ignite(360) b:Ignite(3) c:Ignite(360) end
  if t == 120 then c:Extinguish() end
  local function st(e) if not IsValid(e) then return { "gone" } end return { e:IsOnFire(), e:Health(), e:GetMaxHealth() } end
  if t % 5 == 0 or t < 15 or (IsValid(a) and a:IsOnFire()) then
    samples[#samples+1] = { t = t, a = st(a), b = st(b), c = st(c), fires = #ents.FindByClass("entityflame") }
  end
  if t == 400 then
    hook.Remove("Think", "parity_fire") hook.Remove("EntityTakeDamage", "parity_fire_dmg") hook.Remove("EntityEmitSound", "parity_fire_snd")
    local flames = {}
    for _, f in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("entityflame")) do flames[#flames+1] = { kv = f:GetKeyValues(), parent = IsValid(f:GetParent()) and f:GetParent():GetClass() or "" } end
    local d = crate(Vector(400, -500, -123.6))
    flames.crate_health = { d:Health(), d:GetMaxHealth() }
    d:Ignite(360)
    flames.flame_kv = IsValid(d:GetChildren()[1]) and d:GetChildren()[1]:GetKeyValues() or nil
    d:Remove()
    done({ samples = samples, dmg = dmg, sounds = sounds, flames = flames })
  end
end)
return "async"
